title: Deep underground bases at S4 and Dulce
place_text: S4 Area 51, Nevada; Dulce, New Mexico

tellings.quote: There are also deep underground military bases across the United States and sometimes ones rumored to house other beings at S4 Area 51 or Dulce, New Mexico.

plain: Deep underground military bases are said to lie across the United States, and some are rumored to house other beings: at S4, a site said to sit near Area 51, the secret Air Force test base in Nevada, and at Dulce, New Mexico. Michels says this himself in a 2025 episode. He draws on rumors linked to men named Phil Schneider, Bob Lazar, Dan Burisch and Richard Sauder, without saying what each of them claims.
